source: Mahabharata, Anushasana Parva (public domain). Opening portion; full text pending verification.

meaning.en: Clad in white, all-pervading, moon-hued, four-armed
Meditate on that serene face to remove all obstacles

lines.translit: Om vishvam vishnur vashatkaro bhuta bhavya bhavat prabhuh

meaning.en: He is the universe, all-pervading, lord of past, future and present
Creator and sustainer of beings, their very Self

lines.te: పూతాత్మా పరమాత్మా చ ముక్తానాం పరమా గతిః
lines.translit: Putatma paramatma cha muktanam parama gatih

meaning.en: The pure Self, the Supreme Self, final goal of the liberated

lines.te: అవ్యయః పురుషః సాక్షీ క్షేత్రజ్ఞోఽక్షర ఏవ చ
lines.translit: Avyayah purushah sakshi kshetrajno akshara eva cha

meaning.en: Imperishable, the Person, the witness, knower of the field, eternal
